profile_context: Neutral small-business profile; scenarios specify the task without a contradictory landscaping profile.
limitations: Synthetic operator-labelled regression examples; no claim of real-owner accuracy. Reusing these cases for prompt tuning makes them development data. Cost fields are provider-reported when present, otherwise conservative reservations.

cases.summary: The user runs a dog grooming small business and needs to answer incoming phone calls, capture caller details, and book appointments.
inferred_attributes: caller details are used for lead capture
appointment booking is for dog grooming services

cases.summary: The user wants to prepare a draft quote from job notes for approval. They already have email software but need help generating the quote document.
inferred_attributes: user needs automated quote generation from notes
email will be used to send the quote

cases.summary: The user wants to predict tomorrow's bread demand based on daily sales history to plan stock purchases effectively.
inferred_attributes: business sells bread
needs demand forecasting to optimize inventory

cases.summary: The user wants to enable clients to book appointments directly into their calendar, indicating a need for appointment scheduling functionality.
inferred_attributes: the booking is likely online or via digital means
the calendar is probably digital and connected to the business

cases.summary: Implement a website chatbot that answers customer questions and captures contact details when unable to resolve queries.
inferred_attributes: contact channel is website chat

cases.summary: Extracting receipt and invoice details for bookkeeping purposes to assist the bookkeeper.
inferred_attributes: task involves processing financial documents for bookkeeping

cases.summary: The task is to create and schedule Instagram posts for a craft shop, which is a marketing content creation and scheduling activity.
inferred_attributes: social media marketing
content scheduling

cases.summary: The user wants to send reminders to customers to respond to existing quotes they have already prepared, without generating new quotes.
inferred_attributes: the reminders are likely sent via email or messaging, but the exact channel is not specified

cases.summary: The task is to automate the copying of information between existing software applications (QuickBooks and Gmail) to reduce repetitive office work. This involves connecting software systems to streamline data transfer.
inferred_attributes: integration between accounting and email software
focus on office workflow efficiency

cases.summary: The task involves physical labor (cooking and washing dishes) which is outside the scope of software capabilities and automation solutions.
inferred_attributes: need for human labor
not a software automation task

cases.summary: The user owns a small shop and wants to improve it using AI but has not specified any particular task or area for improvement. Without a defined task or objective, no specific AI capabilities can be recommended.
inferred_attributes: interested in AI solutions
needs guidance to identify improvement areas

cases.summary: The user needs assistance with extracting invoice details from their documents or software.
inferred_attributes: task involves processing invoices likely from QuickBooks or similar software

cases.summary: The user wants to have incoming phone calls answered and caller details recorded for their small business. This involves handling phone calls and capturing lead information from callers.
inferred_attributes: the task involves managing inbound phone communication
lead capture is related to recording caller details

cases.summary: The business needs assistance managing customer enquiries to prevent them from getting lost and to ensure timely responses and follow-ups.
inferred_attributes: customer enquiries are received but not tracked effectively
follow-up communication is currently insufficient or manual

cases.summary: The task is to make outbound cold calls to prospects, which involves outbound sales calls. This is not supported by the available capabilities, as ai_voice_receptionist only covers answering incoming calls, not making outbound calls.
inferred_attributes: task involves outbound sales calls

evaluation_note: All 15 required task sets matched. The raw model missed one contact-clarification flag; the application's deterministic contact-channel gate covers that case. Earlier contradictory-profile evaluation is retained separately.
